title: Rate Lock Commitment Extension Requests for Mail-Away and Power of Attorney Closings
content:
**Closing method and the length of a Rate Lock Commitment extension request.**

When a closing is scheduled on the file in **Closing and Funding** (closing status scheduled or docs out), its closing method decides how many days are added to the days an extension request asks for:

| Scheduled closing's method | Days added |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 1 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | 2 |
| Any other closing method (for example Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing or Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing) | 0 |
| No scheduled closing | 0 |

**Rule as stated.** When a scheduled closing is a Larkspur Mail-Away Closing, the mail-away allowance of **1** day is added. When it is a Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing, the power-of-attorney allowance of **2** days is added. Any other closing method, or no scheduled closing, adds none.

*Hypothetical case:* a file whose Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing reads docs out adds 2 days. If that closing's status read signed or funded instead, no closing would be scheduled in this sense, and no days would be added.
